release.fallback: Version details are on the GitHub releases page.
install.vcc.s1: Select Get it in VCC. If nothing happens, copy the listing URL below and add it in VCC under Settings > Packages > Add Repository.
install.vcc.s2: Open your avatar project in VCC, go to Manage Project and select + next to Avistry.
install.open: In Unity, open Tools > Avistry > Textures.
install.unity.s1: Download the .unitypackage from the button above or from GitHub Releases.
install.unity.s2: With your project open, drag the file into the Project window, or choose Assets > Import Package > Custom Package. Then select Import.
install.git.s1: In Unity, open Window > Package Manager.
install.git.s2: Select +, choose Add package from git URL and paste the URL below.
